original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied APPROVED FICTIONAL CHARACTER portrait into a consistent professional ID-photo composition. The input is the sole identity authority. Preserve exactly this person's facial bone structure, facial proportions, nose, eyes, lips, natural asymmetry, skin tone, age, hairstyle/hairline, glasses if present, clothing and defining details. This is the SAME character, do not invent or beautify a replacement face. Change only camera angle, head orientation, expression and framing: perfectly frontal, camera exactly level with pupils, zero yaw/pitch/roll, eyes looking straight into lens, head upright, shoulders squared symmetrically to lens, calm relaxed neutral expression with lips closed. Standardized close head-and-shoulders ID portrait, portrait 2:3 canvas, 1024x1536 pixels. Entire hair silhouette visible, top of hair at about 8% canvas height, chin about 67%, eye line about 40%, upper chest and both shoulder tops visible, bottom crops upper chest; absolutely no waist or hands. Uniform pure white #FFFFFF seamless background. Bright soft balanced frontal studio lighting, minimal shadows, natural unretouched pores and fine skin texture, extremely subtle halation, photorealistic real-life feeling, 50mm perspective, eyes and entire face sharp, gentle shallow depth of field on shoulders. No side angle, no looking up/down, no head tilt, no fashion posing, no dramatic shadow, no gray gradient background, no text, no border, no watermark. Output ONE portrait only. Character number 01.
